name: Starfall Anchorage
core_rationale: Southernmost tethered basalt sky-island of Continent 03 where bronze anchor-chains and upward waterfalls greet airships and dimensional rift travelers arriving from Continent 02.
local_conflict: Dream-glass wraiths and gravity-leech wyrms are loosening the primary starlight tether-winches that hold the anchorage level.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Navigators say the lighthouse bell at Starfall Anchorage rings backward three seconds before a meteor shower strikes the tether-chains.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A crescent basalt sky-island moored by glowing starlight chains above an upward-falling silver waterfall.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: How can adventurers align the Star-Pendulum receiver to open the rift from Brass Spur Ridge?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater as the southern arrival district of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt anchorage moored by glowing starlight chains and upward-pouring silver waterfalls.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 12.0m decked tether-causeways, 0.65m safety rails, and 0.15m basalt steps for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting Continent 03 Canon readiness and playable leaf maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Includes complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-tether-causeway as a Mystery frontier.
